decisions.reason: As an environmental sensing module that fits the firm’s modular hardware, firmware, API and documentation capabilities, it is close to existing knowledge and therefore more likely to be improved and retained than discontinued.
A voltage measurement module is core to the firm’s established measurement platform and the 3.0 replacement signals strong accumulated learning and low discontinuation risk.
A CAN bus interface builds directly on the firm’s connectivity and embedded-control competences and is commercially relevant for German automation and industrial users, so it is likely to stay.
The carbon dioxide sensor module closely matches the firm’s sensor-module architecture and software support strengths, giving management enough absorptive capacity to refine it rather than remove it.
